headerDisplay: Exposes each Bambu Lab printer's print status as a HomeKit Occupancy Sensor (occupied while actively printing) for use in automations.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: Must be static or DHCP-reserved - the plugin connects directly to this address.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Settings > General on the printer, or the Bambu Handy app device info.

lanAccessCode.title: LAN Access Code
lanAccessCode.description: Settings (cog icon) > General on the printer's touchscreen, shown in green.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify TLS Certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: Bambu printers use a self-signed certificate, so this should normally stay off.

filamentRunoutErrorCodes.title: print_error codes treated as "filament run-out"
filamentRunoutErrorCodes.description: Pre-filled from a community code mapping covering the external-spool and each AMS-slot run-out variant. Add more if the Homebridge log shows an unmatched pause code on a real run-out.

pingieGroupId.title: Pingie Notify! Group ID
pingieGroupId.description: Starts with GRP. Leave both Pingie fields blank to disable notifications.

pingieIconUrl.title: Pingie Notification Icon URL (optional)
pingieIconUrl.description: Small circular sender icon shown next to the title.

pingieImageUrl.title: Pingie Notification Image URL (optional)
pingieImageUrl.description: Larger hero image shown when the notification is expanded. JPEG/PNG/GIF, under 10MB, must be HTTPS.

averagePrintWattage.title: Average Print Power Draw (W)
averagePrintWattage.description: Used only for cost estimates. Leave blank to get duration-only notifications.

electricityRatePencePerKwh.title: Electricity Rate (pence/kWh)
electricityRatePencePerKwh.description: Used only for cost estimates. Leave blank to get duration-only notifications.

progressNotificationIntervalPercent.title: Progress Notification Interval (%)
progressNotificationIntervalPercent.description: Sends a notification every N percent complete, with time remaining. Set to 0 to disable.

includeCameraSnapshot.title: Include a live camera snapshot in notifications
includeCameraSnapshot.description: Requires ffmpeg and the GitHub fields below. Adds a few seconds of latency per notification while the snapshot is captured and uploaded.

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg Path
ffmpegPath.description: Only needed if ffmpeg isn't on your system PATH.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: Fine-grained PAT scoped to only "Contents: read and write" on the repo below - not a broad classic token.

githubRepo.title: GitHub Repo
githubRepo.description: Must be public so raw.githubusercontent.com URLs work without auth.

githubSnapshotPath.title: Snapshot File Path in Repo
githubSnapshotPath.description: This one file gets overwritten each time, rather than accumulating a new file per notification.
